description: This script performs analysis on documentation files to identify missing glossary entries for localized documentation. It processes Git diffs to find changed docs, extracts terms and links from Markdown files, compares against a glossary, and reports missing entries.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for base and head commits.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a Git command with specified arguments and returns the output.

methods.name: resolveBase
methods.description: Determines the Git merge base commit to compare against, using environment variables or common branch names.

methods.name: listChangedDocs
methods.description: Lists documentation files changed between two Git commits within the 'docs' directory.

methods.name: loadGlossarySources
methods.description: Loads the list of glossary terms from the JSON glossary file, returns a set of source references.

methods.name: containsLatin
methods.description: Checks if the provided text contains Latin alphabet characters.

methods.name: wordCount
methods.description: Counts the number of words in a given text string.

methods.name: unquoteScalar
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a scalar string, if present.

methods.name: isGlossaryCandidate
methods.description: Determines if a term qualifies as a candidate for glossary inclusion based on criteria.

methods.name: readGitFile
methods.description: Retrieves the content of a file at a specific commit or branch from Git.

methods.name: extractTerms
methods.description: Extracts glossary terms from Markdown files based on front-matter titles and list items.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function coordinating the script's execution, including argument parsing, diff analysis, and reporting.
